data_fields.name: goal_count
data_fields.donor_constant: integer per objective; increments clamped to remaining goal

data_fields.name: step
data_fields.donor_constant: integer per objective; 0 on every objective = sequence mode

data_fields.name: req_activity_id
data_fields.donor_constant: index of the prerequisite objective; out of range = no prerequisite

data_fields.name: optional
data_fields.donor_constant: bool per objective; optional objectives do not hold the step gate

data_fields.name: experience_reward
data_fields.donor_constant: flat task XP when positive; negative encodes a level-based percent (not ported)

best_idea: Gate each objective with a step number, an optional flag and an optional prerequisite index; recompute the open set on every completion, and pay the task reward exactly once per task instance.
decision_why: Take the gate function and the once-only reward flag as engine logic on server-side objectives; reject the 20-activity client cap and per-increment chat lines (client-protocol details); reject the script-veto hooks as a first cut, because objectives live in the engine, not in quest scripts.
acceptance: Server test on a 3-objective task (kill x3 at step 1 required; talk to Ann at step 1 optional; return to Ann at step 2 required): accept opens kill and talk only; the third kill opens return and leaves talk open; a fourth kill matches nothing; the reward is granted once even if the completion path runs twice.
